# ClashOwl

> ClashOwl is a daily US trademark-watch email alert for small brands. It uses USPTO data to flag new filings that look like your brand, so you can act during the opposition window.

ClashOwl is for small sellers, including Etsy, Amazon and Shopify shops, who want to know when someone files a US trademark close to their name.

- What it does: sends a daily email alert about new US trademark filings similar to your brand
- Who it's for: small brands and independent online sellers in the US
- Data source: USPTO trademark data
- Pricing: $15/mo or $149/yr
- Website: https://clashowl.com

## Guides

- [Someone Filed a Trademark on My Shop Name: A US Seller's Guide](https://clashowl.com/guides/someone-filed-a-trademark-on-my-shop-name.html): what to check, prior-use evidence, the 30-day opposition window, TTAB opposition vs. cancellation, marketplace IP reports and scam messages
- [How to Check if a Shop Name Is Trademarked Before You Use It](https://clashowl.com/guides/how-to-check-if-a-shop-name-is-trademarked.html): searching the USPTO database, what counts as confusingly similar, why related goods matter, common-law use and state registries, and when to call an attorney
